description: Two top-level `handle(request, resolve)` definitions in one file. Per §40 at most one middleware handler exists per file, so E-MW-005 fires (§34: Error) on the second.
rationale: §40 / §39.3.2 — `handle(request, resolve)` is the ONE middleware escape hatch per file: it receives the raw request and bypasses route inference. Two definitions give the pipeline no basis to choose, and picking by source order would make which middleware runs a function of declaration position rather than of anything the author stated.
